Subject: Marquette Shores Hospitality - Referral Required

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for the submission on Marquette Shores Hospitality. I've reviewed the information provided, and this risk requires referral to senior underwriting for the following reasons:

• Hotel class requires additional review
• Total insured value of $52.5M exceeds our standard authority
• Four locations are within 16 km of the coast
• Our existing coastal portfolio concentration in this area is already elevated

I'll need to present this to management for consideration. Before I do, could you please provide:

• Any wind mitigation features or recent upgrades at the coastal properties?
• Confirmation of construction type for each location
• Details on any catastrophe risk management practices

I'll follow up within 3-5 business days after receiving this information.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
